def custom_kernel(
    x_ptr, w_ptr, b_ptr, y_ptr,
    N, C_OUT,
    H_IN, W_IN, H_OUT, W_OUT,
    STRIDE_H, STRIDE_W, PAD_H, PAD_W,
    X_SN, X_SC, X_SH, X_SW,
    W_SO, W_SI, W_SH, W_SW,
    Y_SN, Y_SC, Y_SH, Y_SW,
    BLOCK_P: tl.constexpr,
    BLOCK_CO: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_KW: tl.constexpr, BLOCK_KH: tl.constexpr,
    C_IN: tl.constexpr,
    K_H: tl.constexpr,
    K_W: tl.constexpr,
):
    pid_p = tl.program_id(0)
    pid_co = tl.program_id(1)
    offs_p = pid_p * BLOCK_P + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_P)
    total_p = N * H_OUT * W_OUT
    mask_p = offs_p < total_p
    HW = H_OUT * W_OUT
    n = offs_p // HW
    rem = offs_p - n * HW
    oy = rem // W_OUT
    ox = rem - oy * W_OUT
    offs_co = pid_co * BLOCK_CO + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_CO)
    mask_co = offs_co < C_OUT
    # Accumulator initialized with bias
    acc = tl.zeros((BLOCK_CO, BLOCK_P), dtype=tl.float32)
    bias = tl.load(b_ptr + offs_co.to(tl.int64), mask=mask_co, other=0.0)
    acc += bias[:, None]
    # Vectorized base offsets for input and output along N/H/W
    n64 = n.to(tl.int64)
    oy64 = oy.to(tl.int64)
    ox64 = ox.to(tl.int64)
    x_base_offsets = n64 * X_SN + oy64 * 0 + ox64 * 0  # place holder to keep shape; real offsets below
    x_base_offsets = n64 * X_SN  # corrected; separated below for y/x
    # Convolution loops with KH tiling and x-kw reuse across KH
    for ci in tl.static_range(0, C_IN):
        x_ci_ptr = x_ptr + tl.full((), ci, tl.int64) * X_SC
        w_offsets_co = offs_co.to(tl.int64) * W_SO  # [BLOCK_CO]
        for kh_base in tl.static_range(0, K_H, BLOCK_KH):
            kh_idx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_KH)
            kh = kh_base + kh_idx
            valid_kh = kh < K_H
            in_y_base = oy * STRIDE_H - PAD_H
            in_y_kh = in_y_base[None, :] + kh[:, None]  # [BLOCK_KH, BLOCK_P]
            in_y_kh64 = in_y_kh.to(tl.int64)
            valid_y = (in_y_kh >= 0) & (in_y_kh < H_IN)  # [BLOCK_KH, BLOCK_P]
            for kw_base in tl.static_range(0, K_W, BLOCK_KW):
                kw_idx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_KW)
                kw = kw_base + kw_idx
                valid_kw = kw < K_W
                in_x_base = ox * STRIDE_W - PAD_W  # [BLOCK_P]
                in_x_kw = in_x_base[None, :] + kw[:, None]  # [BLOCK_KW, BLOCK_P]
                in_x_kw64 = in_x_kw.to(tl.int64)
                valid_x_kw = (in_x_kw >= 0) & (in_x_kw < W_IN)  # [BLOCK_KW, BLOCK_P]
                # Build 3D offsets for input [KH, KW, P]
                x_offsets = (
                    n64[None, None, :] * X_SN +
                    in_y_kh64[:, None, :] * X_SH +
                    in_x_kw64[None, :, :] * X_SW
                )  # [BLOCK_KH, BLOCK_KW, BLOCK_P]
                mask_in = (
                    mask_p[None, None, :] &
                    valid_kh[:, None, None] &
                    valid_kw[None, :, None] &
                    valid_y[:, None, :] &
                    valid_x_kw[None, :, :]
                )
                x_vals = tl.load(x_ci_ptr + x_offsets, mask=mask_in, other=0.0)  # [KH, KW, P]
                x_vals = tl.reshape(x_vals, (BLOCK_KH * BLOCK_KW, BLOCK_P))
                # Weight tile [CO, KH, KW]
                w_base_ptr = w_ptr + tl.full((), ci, tl.int64) * W_SI
                w_ptrs = (
                    w_base_ptr
                    + w_offsets_co[:, None, None]
                    + kh.to(tl.int64)[None, :, None] * W_SH
                    + kw.to(tl.int64)[None, None, :] * W_SW
                )  # [BLOCK_CO, BLOCK_KH, BLOCK_KW]
                mask_w = mask_co[:, None, None] & valid_kh[None, :, None] & valid_kw[None, None, :]
                w_vals = tl.load(w_ptrs, mask=mask_w, other=0.0)  # [BLOCK_CO, BLOCK_KH, BLOCK_KW]
                w_vals = tl.reshape(w_vals, (BLOCK_CO, BLOCK_KH * BLOCK_KW))
                acc += tl.dot(w_vals, x_vals)
    y_offsets_px = n64 * Y_SN + oy64 * Y_SH + ox64 * Y_SW
    y_offsets_co = offs_co.to(tl.int64) * Y_SC
    store_mask = mask_co[:, None] & mask_p[None, :]
    tl.store(y_ptr + y_offsets_co[:, None] + y_offsets_px[None, :], acc, mask=store_mask)

    W_OUT = (W_IN + 2 * PAD_W - K_W) // STRIDE_W + 1

    b = torch.randn(C_OUT, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)

    w_t = w.permute(1, 2, 3, 0).contiguous()
    X_SN, X_SC, X_SH, X_SW = [s for s in x.stride()]
    s_ci, s_kh, s_kw, s_co = w_t.stride()
    W_SO, W_SI, W_SH, W_SW = s_co, s_ci, s_kh, s_kw
    Y_SN, Y_SC, Y_SH, Y_SW = [s for s in y.stride()]
    BLOCK_P = 64
    BLOCK_CO = 32
    BLOCK_KW = 16
    BLOCK_KH = 4
    grid = (
        (N * H_OUT * W_OUT + BLOCK_P - 1) // BLOCK_P,
        (C_OUT + BLOCK_CO - 1) // BLOCK_CO,
    )
    custom_kernel[grid](
        x, w_t, b, y,

        STRIDE_H, STRIDE_W, PAD_H, PAD_W,
        X_SN, X_SC, X_SH, X_SW,
        W_SO, W_SI, W_SH, W_SW,

        C_IN=C_IN, K_H=K_H, K_W=K_W,
